resources.string: In EiN on a computer, open Devices and choose this phone, or add it with Create → Device. On its Info tab, choose Pair the app, then scan the QR code it shows.
%1$s did not take the code: %2$s. Choose Pair again on the phone\'s Info tab for a new one.

It is paired with %1$s as %2$s. Pairing with %3$s as %4$s takes its place.
